location_exception_reason: Net houses are promoted under regional government subsidy schemes (NHB/MIDH) with state-specific eligibility criteria; location indicates subsidy applicability and regional climate suitability (Maharashtra, Telangana, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Gujarat have distinct adoption patterns and scheme variations).
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in net house titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently, and removing these words leaves the product description complete and unambiguous.
